name: kde-poppler
description: Poppler PDF library built with Qt6 bindings for KDE Okular and other Qt PDF consumers. Do not install alongside gnome-poppler (same install paths).

user:
cmake -B build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release   \
      -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr  \
      -D CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=$QT6DIR    \
      -D TESTDATADIR=$PWD/build/testfiles \
      -D ENABLE_QT5=OFF             \
      -D ENABLE_QT6=ON              \
      -D ENABLE_UNSTABLE_API_ABI_HEADERS=ON \
      -G Ninja .
